h1.en: Hydraulic Diameter of Circular Tube with Circular Tube on the Inside does not retitle the Kawasaki hydraulic pump on the concrete pump order cells
h1.zh: 「水力直径的圆管 带有 圆管 在 内侧」并不改写只有邢台那一页印了川崎型号，订单才写的格子

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints the figures for Kawasaki hydraulic pump on the concrete pump order. The row to open is /products/electric-40-concrete-pump. It prints Kawasaki 140 double pump. Diesel 60 says Kawasaki double pump 100. Electric 80 says Kawasaki 140 double pump. Diesel 60 prints Kawasaki double pump 100. A single Kawasaki 112 is the Diesel 40 line. Diesel 120 prints Kawasaki 112 as two units. Electric 40, Electric Low Pressure 40 and Diesel 40 print Kawasaki 112. Diesel 50 and Electric 80 print Kawasaki 140, and Electric 80 adds “double pump”. Electric 20, Electric 15, Electric 50 and the rural diesel list used here do not print that name. The section title “Hydraulic Diameter of a Circular Tube or Duct” comes from the source page and does not add a rating.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台印出的是只有邢台那一页印了川崎型号，订单才写的数字。要打开的行是 /products/electric-40-concrete-pump。它印的是川崎 140 双泵。柴油60写川崎双泵 100。柴油60印川崎双泵 100。电动80写川崎 140 双泵。单台川崎 112 是柴油40的行。柴油120把川崎 112 印成两台。电动40、电动低压40和柴油40印川崎 112。柴油50和电动80印川崎 140，电动80还写了“双泵”。此处使用的电动20、电动15、电动50和农村柴油泵列表不印这个名称。节标题「水力直径的圆管 或 风管」来自来源页，不另加额定值。

heading.en: Hydraulic Diameter of a Circular Tube or Duct
heading.zh: 水力直径的圆管 或 风管

body.en: For Kawasaki hydraulic pump on the concrete pump order, the heading “Hydraulic Diameter of a Circular Tube or Duct” does not replace a cell. It prints Kawasaki 140 double pump. A single Kawasaki 112 is the Diesel 40 line. Electric 20, Electric 15, Electric 50 and the rural diesel list used here do not print that name.
body.zh: 对只有邢台那一页印了川崎型号，订单才写而言，标题「水力直径的圆管 或 风管」并不替换任何格子。它印的是川崎 140 双泵。电动40、电动低压40和柴油40印川崎 112。此处使用的电动20、电动15、电动50和农村柴油泵列表不印这个名称。

heading.en: Hydraulic Diameter of Circular Tube with Circular Tube on the Inside
heading.zh: 水力直径的圆管 带有 圆管 在 内侧

body.en: Kawasaki hydraulic pump on the concrete pump order is unchanged by the heading “Hydraulic Diameter of Circular Tube with Circular Tube on the Inside”. Diesel 60 says Kawasaki double pump 100. Diesel 120 prints Kawasaki 112 as two units.
body.zh: 只有邢台那一页印了川崎型号，订单才写不因标题「水力直径的圆管 带有 圆管 在 内侧」而改动。柴油60写川崎双泵 100。柴油120把川崎 112 印成两台。

heading.en: Hydraulic Diameter of Rectangular Tubes or Ducts
heading.zh: 水力直径的矩形管 或 风管

body.en: This section is titled “Hydraulic Diameter of Rectangular Tubes or Ducts”. Kawasaki hydraulic pump on the concrete pump order still prints the cells below. Electric 80 says Kawasaki 140 double pump. Electric 40, Electric Low Pressure 40 and Diesel 40 print Kawasaki 112.
body.zh: 本节标题是「水力直径的矩形管 或 风管」。只有邢台那一页印了川崎型号，订单才写下面这些格子仍是印出来的。柴油50和电动80印川崎 140，电动80还写了“双泵”。单台川崎 112 是柴油40的行。

heading.en: Rectangular to Circulate Duct/Tube Hydraulic Diameter Calculator
heading.zh: 矩形 到 圆形 风管/管 水力直径 计算器

body.en: Under “Rectangular to Circulate Duct/Tube Hydraulic Diameter Calculator”, Kawasaki hydraulic pump on the concrete pump order contributes only the printed cells in this part. Diesel 60 prints Kawasaki double pump 100. Diesel 50 and Electric 80 print Kawasaki 140, and Electric 80 adds “double pump”. The photograph is an image from the source page https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/hydraulic-equivalent-diameter-d_458.html.
body.zh: 在「矩形 到 圆形 风管/管 水力直径 计算器」下，只有邢台那一页印了川崎型号，订单才写这一节只放已印出的格子。柴油60印川崎双泵 100。电动80写川崎 140 双泵。配图来自来源页 https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/hydraulic-equivalent-diameter-d_458.html。

question.en: Does “Hydraulic Diameter of a Circular Tube or Duct” replace It prints Kawasaki 140 double pump?
question.zh: 「水力直径的圆管 或 风管」会替换「它印的是川崎 140 双泵。」吗？

answer.en: No. It prints Kawasaki 140 double pump remains the printed wording for Kawasaki hydraulic pump on the concrete pump order.
answer.zh: 不会。它印的是川崎 140 双泵。仍是只有邢台那一页印了川崎型号，订单才写已印的说法。

question.en: Where does Diesel 60 says Kawasaki double pump 100 belong on the Kawasaki hydraulic pump on the concrete pump order row?
question.zh: 只有邢台那一页印了川崎型号，订单才写这一行里，「柴油60写川崎双泵 100。」放在哪里？

answer.en: It belongs on /products/electric-40-concrete-pump, beside the other printed cells, not under a guessed heading.
answer.zh: 它属于 /products/electric-40-concrete-pump，和其他已印格子在一起，不放到猜出来的标题下面。

question.en: What does “Hydraulic Diameter of Circular Tube with Circular Tube on the Inside” add to Kawasaki hydraulic pump on the concrete pump order?
question.zh: 「水力直径的圆管 带有 圆管 在 内侧」给只有邢台那一页印了川崎型号，订单才写增加了什么？

answer.en: It is only the section title taken from https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/hydraulic-equivalent-diameter-d_458.html. It does not add a performance figure.
answer.zh: 它只是取自 https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/hydraulic-equivalent-diameter-d_458.html 的节标题，不增加性能数字。
